'''January 2001 Parker tournament (6 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 6 January 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1607">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-parker-co-1-6-01-end-of-an-erad1607/ parker-co-1-6-01-end-of-an-era], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 8 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-parker-co-1-6-01-end-of-an-erad1607/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 25
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
